title: Claude Code Style Transfer Skills Enable Stylistic Rewriting Without Retraining
summary: Two skills for Claude Code/Codex allow rewriting any text in a specific author's voice without fine-tuning. The first skill extracts style profiles from channel archives by measuring linguistic features. The second skill applies these rules to rewrite drafts. The profile persists as a git-tracked text file, enabling ongoing use across models.
